resolve.armed: Press again to save it. Above is what GOTCHA will read, word for word - nothing is used until you do.

problem.not_found: This suggestion is no longer there. Someone may have decided it already - reload to see where it stands.
problem.forbidden: You do not have permission to change the knowledge base. Whoever administers GOTCHA for you can do this or grant it.
problem.too_long: One of these answers is too long to save as it stands. Shorten it in the knowledge base after approving a shorter one, or edit it there directly.
problem.failed: We could not save that just now, and nothing was written. Try again in a moment.
